item.title: Monaghan into Dr Mc Kenna cup final
item.description: Monaghan will face Donegal in the Bank of Ireland Dr Mc Kenna cup final on Saturday evening. That was after both sides registered wins in their semi finals over Tyrone and Derry last night. item.title: Local calls for extension of gritting route for Mountnugent road
item.description: A local councillor has called for an extension of road gritting routes to include the L7081 in Mountnugent. Cllr Trevor Smith called on the local authority to include the route that runs close to the Meath border on the regular gritting route going forward. The Sheelin Nursing home is located along the L7081 and the Fine Gael councillor says while it's a route that has been gritted during very bad cold spells, a regular salting of the road is needed. item.title: Cavan councillor supports calls for vaping ban in pubs
item.description: A local county councillor is supporting calls for a ban of vaping in pubs. Brendan Fay is the owner of the Widow's Bar in Belturbet and he believes vape products should be included under the smoking ban. Cllr Fay is an advocate for banning single use vapes throughout the island of Ireland, as he believes the harm they are doing to people, particularly young people is not yet even understood properly. item.title: Peter Galligan
item.description: Peter Galligan Glasscarrick, Loughduff, Cavan. Peter Galligan passed away on Wednesday, January 14th, 2026. Peacefully, in the loving care of his devoted family. Predeceased by his parents, Conor and Frances (née Moynagh), his brother Patrick, sister Sr. Margaret (Sisters of Mercy, Colwyn Bay) and his darling Grandson, Tiarnán. Forever loved and sadly missed by his devoted family, loving wife Brigid, children Claire (Kevin), Paula (Kevin), Conor (Roslyn), Irene (Tim), Peter Paul, David (Laura).

item.title: Appeal issued over spate of burglaries in Cavan Town
item.description: Gardai have reissued their appeal for information following a number of burglaries which were reported in the Cavan Town area. According to Gardai, all burglaries took place on the same date of December 11th. A burglary took place in Glenlara between the hours of 7pm and 8:30pm Advertisement A private dwelling was forcibly entered through the rear door and a room in the house was ransacked. item.title: Monaghan people invited to create wildlife areas
item.description: Landowners, schools and community groups in Monaghan are being invited to apply for support to create wildlife areas. This is a part of the 'Hare's Corner' initiative, which aims to make more space for nature. The name pays comes from an old label for a piece of land that could not be farmed and was left to nature. item.description: A 35-year-old man has been further remanded on bail at Monaghan Circuit Court in relation to dangerous driving causing the death of another man. item.title: Momentum grows for additional Gaelscoileanna in Cavan
item.description: Local councillor Stiofán Conaty has welcomed news that CMETB is to discuss the establishment of new Irish-medium primary schools in County Cavan. item.title: Govt set to increase local road funding
item.description: An increase in funding for local roads is set to be announced for Cavan and Monaghan later this month. That's according to the Minister for Transport, Darragh O'Brien. Speaking in the Dáil this morning, local TD Matt Carthy asked the minister if there would be a "substantial" increase in road funding in 2026 for the local region.
